title: Transparent background

alpha_verification.method: ImageMagick identify on the downloaded result.webp

notes: params.transparent selects Layer Diffuse, which produces a cut-out subject on a transparent background instead of a painted backdrop. Prompts that describe a single isolated subject separate far more cleanly than scenes. The returned webp carries a real alpha channel, so keep it as webp or png; converting to jpeg discards the cut-out.
